positions.name: QuantumDbMigrationRationale
positions.frame: what justifies switching the analytics pipeline from PostgreSQL to QuantumDB?
positions.why: Dave's original assertion (src-1) pairs the switch with two proportional benefits — 10x query performance and lower licensing cost — and the two claims are independently restated as line items in Xena's decision summary (src-2 names the migration itself, src-3 restates the performance figure). All three read in the direction of cost/benefit justification: rational-persuasion and market-pricing framing recur across them (per the relational and power reads), and the value reads converge on openness-to-change/self-enhancement appeals. The timeline item (src-4) does not share this justificatory shape — it reads as a directive/pressure commitment rather than a rationale claim — so it is left out of this group despite sitting in the same summary block.
